The **Manipulation** group of the node palette has 26 nodes: 22 run, 4 cannot run yet or are deprecated.

| Node | Status | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [Binning](../manipulation/binning.md) | Runs | Bin one numeric column. |
| [Cell Extractor](../manipulation/cell-extractor.md) | Runs | Extract value from specific cell. |
| [Cell Updater](../manipulation/cell-updater.md) | Runs | Update value in specific cell. |
| [Check](../manipulation/check.md) | Runs | Stop the run unless the data holds: a row count, allowed values, unique, not empty or a range. |
| [Column Appender](../manipulation/column-appender.md) | Runs | Append columns from multiple tables. |
| [Column Filter](../manipulation/column-filter.md) | Runs | Select columns. |
| [Cross Tabulation](../manipulation/cross-tabulation.md) | Can't run yet | Cross Tabulation is planned and not yet available in the runtime. |
| [Duplicate Remover](../manipulation/duplicate-remover.md) | Runs | Remove duplicates. |
| [GroupBy](../manipulation/groupby.md) | Runs | Group rows and aggregate numbers or ordered text. |
| [Joiner](../manipulation/joiner.md) | Runs | Join two tables by matching key columns. |
| [Math Formula](../manipulation/math-formula.md) | Runs | Apply math formula to create/modify columns. |
| [Missing Value](../manipulation/missing-value.md) | Runs | Handle missing values. |
| [Pivot Table](../manipulation/pivot-table.md) | Can't run yet | Pivot Table is planned and not yet available in the runtime. |
| [Polynomial Features](../manipulation/polynomial-features.md) | Runs | Generate polynomial features for one numeric column. |
| [Rename Columns](../manipulation/rename-columns.md) | Runs | Rename one or more columns. |
| [Row Appender](../manipulation/row-appender.md) | Runs | Append rows from multiple tables (UNION) |
| [Row Filter](../manipulation/row-filter.md) | Runs | Filter rows by condition. |
| [Row to Column Names](../manipulation/row-to-column-names.md) | Runs | Promote a row to column headers. |
| [Rule Engine](../manipulation/rule-engine.md) | Runs | Apply if-then-else rules to create/modify columns. |
| [Sorter](../manipulation/sorter.md) | Runs | Sort rows. |
| [SQL Query](../manipulation/sql-query.md) | Runs | Transform the input table with one read-only SQL SELECT. |
| [String Manipulation](../manipulation/string-manipulation.md) | Runs | String operations on columns. |
| [Table Cropper](../manipulation/table-cropper.md) | Runs | Crop table to specified dimensions. |
| [Table Splitter](../manipulation/table-splitter.md) | Can't run yet | Split table at specified row. |
| [Union Tables](../manipulation/union-tables.md) | Can't run yet | Union Tables is planned and not yet available in the runtime. |
| [Unpivot](../manipulation/unpivot.md) | Runs | Unpivot wide to long format. |
